# Test audio

Two short clips for the transcription tests, cut from LibriVox recordings. All LibriVox
recordings are in the public domain. They were converted to 16 kHz mono and encoded as
Opus at 24 kb/s.

| File | Source | Words |
|---|---|---|
| `en-librivox.opus` | LibriVox, *Alice's Adventures in Wonderland*, chapter 1, read by Kristen McQuillin: 0.9–5.75 s | "This is a LibriVox recording. All LibriVox recordings are in the public domain." |
| `fr-librivox.opus` | LibriVox, *Lettres de mon moulin*, "Le secret de maître Cornille", read by Naf: 0.9–7.9 s | "Le secret de maître Cornille, des Lettres de mon moulin. Cet enregistrement LibriVox fait partie du domaine public." |
